name: vibe-me-mux
description: Mux plugin: kunwei addon as a standalone repo (editor, greper, runner, reverie, browser, fuzzy, review-loop, caps, syntax-check)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --bundle && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
